# Primordial Items

by VisionGLLast Updated: September 3, 2025

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Primordial Items are enhanced versions of Unique and Exalted gear, introduced in Season 3. These items are more powerful than the usual Unique and Exalted Items. You may equip only one Primordial Item at a time. This limitation makes it essential to consider carefully which Primordial Item best supports your build.

## Primordial Item Categories

Primordial Items
Primordial Items come in two main types: Primordial Uniques and Primordial Exalted Items. Each type provides different benefits, depending on your build. As a general rule, if your build does not benefit from a specific Primordial Unique, you should choose a Primordial Exalted Item instead, since you can tailor it more precisely to what your build needs.

### Primordial Uniques

Primordial Uniques provide transformative effects that can dramatically alter gameplay. These effects may grant +Levels to All Skills, enable super critical hits called Deadly Strikes, allow you to summon a T-Rex, or increase the effectiveness of your Idols.

Primordial Uniques can gain Legendary Potential and be placed in the Eternity Cache to create Legendaries. These items roll for Legendary Potential at the time of purchase, or when dropped from Rift Beasts.

There are currently 25 Primordial Uniques in the game. You can purchase 22 of them from Skarven Bloodhorn, while three drop exclusively from Rift Beasts. Additionally, Rift Beasts can also drop any of the Primordial Uniques.

### Primordial Exalted Items

Primordial Exalted Items feature Tier 8 Affixes, which are 50–100% more effective than their Tier 7 counterparts. Every Affix in the game can become Primordial Exalted Affixes, though Primordial Champion Affixes can only appear as drops and can't be crafted.

The Primordial Sealed Affix does not use the regular Sealed Affix slot. This means, under optimal conditions, Primordial Exalted Items can hold up to 6 Affixes total.

When creating a Legendary, you cannot select Primordial Affixes as Legendary Affixes within the Eternity Cache.

## Finding Primordial Items

Primordial Items
You primarily find Primordial Items by interacting with the Primal Hunt mechanic. Purchase Primordial Uniques using Primordial Materials or obtain them by slaying Rift Beasts. You craft Primordial Exalted Items using the Rune of Evolution, which you also purchase with Primordial Materials, or acquire Primordial Exalted Champion Affixes from the Bloodline Glade Woven Echo.

Primal Hunts

Learn more about Primal Hunts with our Primal Hunts Guide.

### Primordial Uniques

There are 25 Primordial Uniques in total. You can purchase 22 from Skarven Bloodhorn using Primordial Materials collected from Primal Hunts. The remaining three drop only from Rift Beasts. You can find Skarven Bloodhorn in The Garden in Chapter 10 and within Mysterious Rifts. You can continue purchasing Primordial Uniques as long as you have the required Primordial Materials. Primordial Uniques purchased from Skarven Bloodhorn are rolled for Legendary Potential at the time of purchase.

Rift Beasts can also drop all Primordial Uniques. Their chance to drop Primordial Uniques scales with the number of active Evolutions they possess. The Primordial Materials that your specific Rift Beast drops can also influence the drop chance if those materials are part of the Primordial Unique's usual vendor cost. Corruption and Circle of Fortune Rank bonuses further affect the Primordial Unique drop rate.

### Primordial Exalted Items

You craft Primordial Exalted Items using the Rune of Evolution, purchased from Skarven Bloodhorn. Applying a Rune of Evolution to an item with at least one T7 Affix upgrades one random T7 Affix to a T8 Affix and Seals it, freeing an additional Affix slot. If an item has multiple T7 Affixes, each has an equal chance to be selected for upgrade. T8 Affixes provide 50% to 100% greater effect than T7 Affixes.

The Rune of Evolution does not affect T7 Champion Affixes. However, you can obtain Primordial Exalted Champion Affixes from the Bloodline Glade Woven Echo. You can upgrade all other types of Affixes into Primordial Exalted stats.

### Imprinting and Primordial Items

For an Imprinted Item to drop, it must meet the exact drop requirements of the original item. This means that any Primordial Unique that you Imprint can only be found when slaying Rift Beasts. Don’t Imprint Primordial Uniques in your Weaver Tree unless you are specifically farming Rift Beasts for copies of a Primordial Unique. However, since Imprint slots are limited and Rift Beast encounters are sporadic, these slots are better used for farming other items.

When you Imprint Primordial Exalted Items, the Primordial Exalted Stat counts as a T7. Imprinting Primordial Exalted Items can help you see similar drops, but you cannot naturally obtain a T8 this way. You can, however, use a Rune of Evolution on the resulting T7 items to create a T8 on the new item.

## Summary

Primordial Items
- Primordial Uniques and Primordial Exalted Items are more powerful than standard Uniques and Exalted Items. You can equip only one Primordial Item at a time.
- Primordial Uniques grant transformative effects that can significantly change gameplay.
- There are 25 Primordial Unique items in total. You can purchase 22 from Skarven Bloodhorn, while 3 drop exclusively from Rift Beasts. In addition to this, Rift Beasts can drop any Primordial Unique.
- You craft Primordial Exalted Items using the Rune of Evolution. Primordial Exalted Champion Affixes drop from Rift Beasts within the Bloodline Glade Woven Echo.
- Primordial Exalted Stats Seal separately from normal Sealed Affixes, allowing Primordial Exalted Items to have up to six Affixes in total. These T8 stats provide 50–100% greater effect than T7 stats.
